name: NewsJet for Miniflux
tagline: A simple Android client for your Miniflux news reader
description:
NewsJet is a simple Android client for Miniflux, the open source, self-hosted feed reader. If you already run your own Miniflux server, NewsJet gives you a native app to read your feeds from your phone instead of using a browser.

It's early in development, built by someone who wanted a proper mobile client for their own Miniflux setup, a lightweight option worth keeping an eye on.
